happy.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor.
So remember Me; I will remember you.
And He found you lost and guided you.
And remember the favor of Allah upon you.
And my success is not but through Allah.

sad.translation: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
And despair not of relief from Allah.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth.
And give good tidings to the patient.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

hope.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ
hope.translation: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

hope.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
hope.translation: Indeed, Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.
For indeed, with hardship will be ease.
And Allah is the best of providers.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

patience.translation: And seek help through patience and prayer.

patience.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
patience.translation: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
So be patient with gracious patience.
And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger.
O you who believe, persevere and endure.

gratitude.translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor.
So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me.
And few of My servants are grateful.

gratitude.arabic: لَّىِٕن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ
gratitude.translation: If you disbelieve, indeed Allah is Free from need of you.

guidance.translation: Guide us to the straight path.
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways.

guidance.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ
guidance.translation: Indeed, this Quran guides to that which is most suitable.

guidance.arabic: يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلْعُسْرَ
guidance.translation: Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship.

guidance.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا
guidance.translation: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.

trust.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ
trust.translation: And whoever puts his trust in Allah, He will be enough for him.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
And my success is not but through Allah.
And Allah is predominant over His affair.
And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.

peace.translation: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

peace.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
peace.translation: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers.
And Allah invites to the Home of Peace.

peace.arabic: فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
peace.translation: So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are believers.

angry.translation: Who restrain anger and who pardon the people.

angry.arabic: خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
angry.translation: Take what is given freely, and command what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

angry.arabic: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ
angry.translation: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel evil by that which is better.
And who, when they are angry, they forgive.

anxious.translation: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

anxious.arabic: فَلَا تَخَافُوهُمْ وَخَافُونِ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
anxious.translation: So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are believers.
Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

anxious.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا
anxious.translation: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.

blessed.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am.

blessed.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ تِبْيَـٰنًۭا لِّكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ
blessed.translation: And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things.

blessed.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ
blessed.translation: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them.

blessed.arabic: وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَمَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
blessed.translation: And whatever thing you have been given - it is but for enjoyment of the worldly life.

good.translation: And do good; indeed, Allah loves those who do good.
So race to all that is good.
Whoever does righteousness - it is for his own soul.

good.arabic: وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ
good.translation: And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah.
